messages:
carla: Quick follow-up from today's authz postmortem. Short summary: token rotation + deploy ordering caused ~2m of stale-claim responses; audit shipper missed ~20s during a consumer rebalance. Need explicit owners + short remediation steps.
rishi: Can we get a minimal repro and suggested quick mitigations?
carla: Repro in incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2284000123. Minimal: rotate secret -> validators restart -> gateway still serves from cache until TTL or 401 triggers revalidate. If revalidate coincides with consumer rebalance, events drop. Quick mitigations: 1) invalidate cache on rotation event, 2) revalidate on 401, 3) add small local buffer + retry to audit shipper.
ben: I can own event-driven invalidation. Will implement feature-flagged hook from rotation service to invalidate relevant caches. Small PR, ETA: Thu COB.
rishi: I'll own the gateway safe-path: on 401 do a synchronous validation call with short timeout and a counter so we don't amplify load. Add integration test. ETA: Mon.
infra-sre: I'll harden audit shipper: bounded local buffer (30s), idempotent retries, and a temporary consumer-lag alert at kafka.consumer.lag > 3000. Also propose a soft throttle on rotation jobs during high lag. ETA: tomorrow AM.
carla: Nice. Let's capture action items in the ticket so oncall has a single source of truth: 
- [ ] BEN: PR for rotation->cache-invalidate hook (feature flag)
- [ ] RISHI: revalidate-on-401 + integration test
- [ ] INFRA-SRE: audit-shipper buffer + retry + alert rule
- [ ] CARLA: update runbook with manual "force-refresh" step and an example curl for oncall

carla: Example curl for oncall repro: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROTATED_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/resource` then run `scripts/force-refresh-tokens --service gateway --dry-run` if 401s spike.
ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1703 - feature flag `auth.invalidate_on_rotation`. Requesting review from @rishi and @infra-sre.
rishi: Test harness PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/gateway/pulls/94 - revalidate-on-401 + deploy-order e2e.
infra-sre: Infra PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/912 - buffer + retry + alert. Added temporary throttle for rotation jobs per-region.
sec-bot: Created SEC-3150: "rotation-cache-audit-gap" and linked SRV-4610. Watchers: carla, rishi, ben, infra-sre. Status: in_progress.
carla: Scheduling a 15m handoff tomorrow 09:00 PST to walk rollout and rollback criteria. Bring PR links and smoke tests. We'll run daily 10m standups until all items closed. :thumbsup:
ben: ack
rishi: ack
infra-sre: ack
sec-bot: SEC-3150 status updated: owners assigned, due in 7 days.
